Ward Medical Unit — Continuation sheet.
Hospital No: 0001049f-9248-47fe-b479-ea80eb51ce4a
Doc: 0001049f-9248-47fe-b479-ea80eb51ce4a
ward_round
13/03/2020 12:29

Background: Admitted to hospital at 12:21 on 11/03/2020 with suspected COVID-19
pneumonia and hypoxaemia (SpO2 <92% on air at 06:52 on 11/03/2020). SARS-CoV-2 PCR
confirmed positive, reported 21:50 on 11/03/2020.

Observations today: Temperature 37.4°C, HR 92 bpm, RR 22/min, SpO2 95% on 2L nasal
cannula, BP 128/76 mmHg. NEWS2 3, improving trend.

Blood: CRP falling (from 148 to 96 mg/L), lymphocytes 0.9 x10^9/L, renal function normal,
D-dimer mildly elevated.

VTE prophylaxis: Enoxaparin out of stock on the ward; first dose given once pharmacy
delivered supply the next day. First dose given 07:38 on 13/03/2020. No bleeding risk
identified, mechanical prophylaxis with TEDS used in the interim.

Escalation status: For ward-based care; full escalation discussed with patient and family, not
for ICU at present given improving trajectory, for review if deteriorates.

Plan: Continue supportive care and oxygen weaning as tolerated. Daily bloods and observations.
Continue enoxaparin on. Physciotherapy input for mobilisation. Review chest X-ray. Consider
stepping down oxygen if SpO2 maintained >94% on air. Discuss discharge planning once stable
off oxygen for 24 hours.

Ward
